discovery.target_raw: 140-150 distinct employer-level candidates if sources allow
discovery.note: Reviewed fresh regional job-board surfaces across Novosibirsk, Cheboksary, Ufa, Krasnodar, Samara and Kazan. Only employer-level entities explicitly visible and reviewed were counted. Repeated listings, recruiter-only rows, public-sector entities and entities not resolved enough for employer-level counting were not counted. The target was not inflated when the available indexed surfaces did not yield enough low-overlap verified employers within the run.
